what_to_detect: A VillainousChoice resolution whose effect half holds the events of the chosen option's actions, whatever their type, for the player facing the choice. Why no family fits: outcome_event requires one event type, but the chosen option's actions vary by card (draw, discard, damage, life loss). VillainousChoice emits no choice_made (not in ApiEvents.choiceRules), so a declaration on choice_made matches nothing and tags every VillainousChoice resolution a near miss. api reads the line's root API, so a card whose VillainousChoice is a sub-ability (root Token) is not covered.
near_miss: A VillainousChoice resolution whose effect half holds no event: no option's action was performed.
